name: ldaca-web-app
description: LDaCA Text Analytics Platform - Web and Desktop Applications

scripts.desktop:build:mac: npm run prepare:backend && tauri build && npx create-dmg "src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/LDaCA Text Analytics.app" "src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/" --overwrite --no-code-sign
scripts.desktop:build:windows: echo 'Run this on Windows to build .msi' && npm run prepare:backend && tauri build
scripts.prepare:backend: cd backend && uv run python scripts/package_backend_runtime.py --clean
scripts.prepare:all: npm run prepare:backend && npm run prepare:frontend
scripts.clean: npm run -w frontend clean && cd src-tauri && cargo clean
